description: HubSpot only: when the team's CRM isn't HubSpot, use crm-pipeline-pulse. Pipeline snapshot of the user's open deals — by stage, activity age, next step and closing date — with stalled deals flagged, a forecast, suggested follow-up tasks and out/pipeline-<date>.md. Use on "how's my pipeline", "show me my deals", "pipeline overview", "pipeline status", "which deals are stalling", "pipeline review", "weekly pipeline", "pipeline health", "forecast this quarter". Not for a data-quality audit of the CRM (crm-audit).
